selection_rules.threshold: per experiment, on DEV only: maximize DEV macro group accuracy over the (source,label) groups TT/ATTACK, JLL/ATTACK, JLL/BENIGN, security_docs/BENIGN, arxiv/BENIGN; grid 0.01..0.99
selection_rules.candidate: highest DEV macro group accuracy at its DEV threshold; tie-break DEV PR-AUC
selection_rules.calibration: temperature scaling fitted on DEV only for every experiment; raw and calibrated reported
selection_rules.test: TEST1 (pool TEST) and TEST2 (OOD) run once, after selection is frozen, for all experiments
